messages:
olivia_finance: Flagging an Azure Marketplace billing gap for May. Reseller discount not applied to channel invoice for partner ID AZ-445. Looks like pricing band mapping dropped during the SKU migration. Estimated impact ~$7,250. Anyone seen the new "pricing_band" field in the marketplace CSV?

max_revops: Seen it. Azure added a new `pricing_band` column in the May export. Our mapping table expected `reseller_tier` and wasn't updated, so discounts weren't applied during billing assembly.

sasha_billing: Confirmed. Raw export sample from blob storage (az_marketplace/2026/05/31/part-02.csv):
```
invoice,partner_id,sku,usage_amount,pricing_band,reseller_tier
inv-20260531,AZ-445,sku-edge-1,7250,band-c,
```

devon_partner_ops: Partner will notice net amount higher. We need to move fast: either backdate an adjustment or issue a manual credit. What's the delta per partner?

olivia_finance: Total delta = $7,250. This is the reseller discount that should have been applied (15%). Our billing job applied full list price.

azure-marketplace-bot: Azure Marketplace notice: "pricing_band" column added for tiered discounts; partners may experience missing reseller_tier in exports during SKU migration windows. https://azure.example/marketplace/notice (automated)

sasha_billing: Proposed action: 1) quick fix to billing job to prefer `pricing_band` then fallback to `reseller_tier`; 2) re-run billing assembly for May invoices for affected partner list; 3) if Azure allows invoice adjustments, request a backdated credit, otherwise issue manual credit memo.

max_revops: I approve manual credit up to $10k for individual partner incidents; record approval here for audit. Please include this thread in the approvals doc.

olivia_finance: Approved by Finance: issue credit memo for $7,250 if Azure cannot back-adjust. @sasha_billing create ticket and schedule reassembly. Also loop in Legal for messaging.

sasha_billing: Created ticket BILL-3302 (billing mapping: pricing_band fallback). PR opened: billing/PR-558. Reassembly scheduled 2026-06-02 03:00 UTC. Will post reassembly results and whether Azure accepted adjustment.

devon_partner_ops: I'll prepare partner-facing note explaining cause and next steps. Prefer to send comms after we confirm reassembly outcome so we include corrected invoice/credit.

olivia_finance: Good. If reassembly shows systemic exposure > $10k across partners, we'll escalate to head of finance. For now tracking this as a single-partner incident.

sasha_billing: Reassembly dry-run completed locally: corrected net = $7,250 (credit required). Opening support case with Azure to request backdated invoice adjustment: case AZ-CASE-881.

max_revops: Recording approval: manual credit $7,250 for AZ-445 approved by Max RevOps on 2026-06-01.

olivia_finance: Thanks everyone. Keep this thread updated and drop final memo into finance-approvals.
